an7.66:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati ambapālīvane.
an7.66:2.4: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccituṃ
an7.66:3.1: sineru bhikkhave pabbatarājā caturāsītiyojanasahassāni āyāmena caturāsītiyojanasahassāni vitthārena caturāsītiyojanasahassāni mahāsamudde ajjhogāḷho caturāsītiyojanasahassāni mahāsamuddā accuggato
an7.66:3.2: hoti kho so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni bahūni vassasatasahassāni devo na vassati
an7.66:3.3: deve kho pana bhikkhave avassante yekecime vījagāmabhūtagāmaosathatiṇavanappatayo te ussussanti vissussanti na bhavanti
an7.66:3.5: evaṃ adhuvā bhikkhave saṅkhārā evaṃ anassāsikā bhikkhave saṅkhārā yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ
an7.66:4.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena dutiyo suriyo pātubhavati
an7.66:4.2: dutiyassa bhikkhave suriyassa pātubhāvā yākāci kunnadiyo kussobbhā sabbā tā ussussanti vissussanti na bhavanti
an7.66:5.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena tatiyo suriyo pātubhavati
an7.66:5.2: tatiyassa bhikkhave suriyassa pātubhāvā yā tā mahānadiyo seyyathīdaṃ
an7.66:5.3: gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī sabbā tā ussussanti vissussanti na bhavanti
an7.66:6.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena catuttho suriyo pātubhavati
an7.66:6.2: catutthassa bhikkhave suriyassa pātubhāvā ye te mahāsarā yato imā mahānadiyo sambhavanti seyyathīdaṃ
an7.66:6.3: gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī sabbe te ussussanti vissussanti na bhavanti
an7.66:7.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena pañcamo suriyo pātubhavati
an7.66:7.2: pañcamassa bhikkhave suriyassa pātubhāvā yojanasatikānipi mahāsamudde udakāni ogacchanti dviyojanasatikānipi tiyojanasatikānipi catuyojanasatikānipi pañcayojanasatikānipi chayojanasatikānipi sattayojanasatikānipi mahāsamudde udakāni ogacchanti
an7.66:7.3: sattatālampi mahāsamudde udakaṃ saṇṭhāti chatālampi pañcatālampi catutālampi titālampi dvitālampi tālamattampi mahāsamudde udakaṃ saṇṭhāti
an7.66:7.4: sattaporisampi mahāsamudde udakaṃ saṇṭhāti chaporisampi pañcaporisampi catuporisampi tiporisampi dviporisampi porisamattampi aḍḍhaporisampi kaṭimattampi jannukamattampi goppakamattampi mahāsamudde udakaṃ saṇṭhāti
an7.66:7.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhave saradasamaye thullaphusitake deve vassante tattha tattha gopadesu udakāni ṭhitāni honti
an7.66:7.6: evameva kho bhikkhave tattha tattha gopadamattāni mahāsamudde udakāni ṭhitāni honti
an7.66:7.7: pañcamassa bhikkhave suriyassa pātubhāvā aṅgulipabbamattampi mahāsamudde udakaṃ na hoti
an7.66:8.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena chaṭṭho suriyo pātubhavati
an7.66:8.2: chaṭṭhassa bhikkhave suriyassa pātubhāvā ayañca mahāpaṭhavī sineru ca pabbatarājā dhūpāyanti sandhūpāyanti sampadhūpāyanti
an7.66:8.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kumbhakārapāko ālimpito dhūpeti sandhūpeti sampadhūpeti evameva
an7.66:8.4: kho bhikkhave chaṭṭhassa suriyassa pātubhāvā ayañca mahāpaṭhavī sineru ca pabbatarājā dhūpāyanti sandhūpāyanti
an7.66:9.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena sattamo suriyo pātubhavati
an7.66:9.2: sattamassa bhikkhave suriyassa pātubhāvā ayañca mahāpaṭhavī sineru ca pabbatarājā ādippanti pajjalanti ekajālā bhavanti
an7.66:9.3: imassā ca bhikkhave mahāpaṭhaviyā sinerussa ca pabbatarājassa jhāyamānānaṃ dayhamānānaṃ acci vātena khittā yāva brahmalokāpi gacchati
an7.66:9.4: sinerussa bhikkhave pabbatarājassa jhāyamānassa dayhamānassa vinassamānassa mahatā tejokhandhena abhibhūtassa yojanasatakānipi kūṭāni palujjanti dviyojanasatikānipi tiyojanasatikānipi catuyojanasatikānipi pañcayojanasatikānipi kūṭāni palujjanti
an7.66:9.5: imassā ca bhikkhave mahāpaṭhaviyā sinerussa ca pabbatarājassa jhāyamānānaṃ dayhamānānaṃ neva chārikā paññāyati na masi
an7.66:9.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave sappissa vā telassa vā jhāyamānassa dayhamānassa neva chārikā paññāyati na masi
an7.66:9.7: evameva kho bhikkhave imassā ca mahāpaṭhaviyā sinerussa ca pabbatarājassa jhāyamānānaṃ dayhamānānaṃ neva chārikā paññāyati na masi
an7.66:9.11: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccituṃ
an7.66:10.1: tatra bhikkhave ko mantā ko saddhātā
an7.66:10.2: ayañca paṭhavī sineru ca pabbatarājā dayhissanti vinassissanti na bhavissantīti aññatra diṭṭhapadehi.
an7.66:11.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave sunetto nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo
an7.66:11.2: sunettassa kho pana bhikkhave satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ
an7.66:11.3: sunetto satthā sāvakānaṃ brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ deseti
an7.66:11.4: ye kho pana bhikkhave sunettassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṃ desentassa sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājāniṃsu te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ brahmalokaṃ upapajjiṃsu
an7.66:11.5: ye na sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājāniṃsu te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā appekacce paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjiṃsu appekacce nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjiṃsu appekacce tusitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjiṃsu appekacce yāmānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjiṃsu appekacce tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjiṃsu appekacce cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjiṃsu appekacce khattiyamahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjiṃsu appekacce brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjiṃsu appekacce gahapatimahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjiṃsu.
an7.66:12.2: na kho metaṃ paṭirūpaṃ yohaṃ sāvakānaṃ samasamagatiyo assaṃ abhisamparāyaṃ yannūnāhaṃ uttariṃ mettaṃ bhāveyyanti
an7.66:13.1: athakho bhikkhave sunetto satthā satta vassāni mettacittaṃ bhāvesi
an7.66:13.2: satta vassāni mettacittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na yimaṃ lokaṃ punāgamāsi
an7.66:13.3: saṃvaṭṭamāne sudaṃ bhikkhave loke ākassarūpago hoti
an7.66:13.5: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave brahmā hoti mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī
an7.66:13.6: chattiṃsakkhattuṃ kho pana bhikkhave sakko ahosi devānamindo
an7.66:13.7: anekasatakkhattuṃ rājā ahosi cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato
an7.66:13.8: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā ahesuṃ sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā
an7.66:13.9: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasi
an7.66:13.10: so hi nāma bhikkhave sunetto satthā evaṃdīghāyuko samāno evaṃciraṭṭhitiko aparimutto ahosi
an7.66:13.11: jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi aparimutto mutto dukkhasmāti vadāmi
an7.66:14.4: ariyassa sīlassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā ariyassa samādhissa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā ariyāya paññāya ananubodhā appaṭivedhā ariyāya vimuttiyā ananubodhā appaṭivedhā
an7.66:14.5: tayidaṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ sīlaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ ariyo samādhi anubuddho paṭividdho ariyā paññā anubuddhā paṭividdhā ariyā vimutti anubuddhā paṭividdhā ucchinnā bhavataṇhā khīṇā bhavanetti natthidāni punabbhavoti.
an7.66:14.7: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
